reason: Stage50 shows exterior relation errors can make true sign accuracy worse with more iterations even while raw MSE improves. Test whether a scalar suppression of unreliable exterior messages can help, and whether it harms intact relations.
model: Original 16-step recurrence, multiply only non-query-adjacent assumed off-diagonal edges by a shared gate. No new observations or target labels at inference.
fit: Choose one gate by maximum empirical calibration classification accuracy, another by minimum raw normalized MSE. 5 calibration seeds, only 50% corrupted exterior edges. Ties favor smaller gate.
primary: Classification-selected gate versus gate1 in heldout 50%-corruption condition. Positive seed paired CI. Report price of using unchanged gate at 0% corruption.
inference_work: All gated policies nominally execute same 16 dense recurrence sweeps in this reference implementation; no online labels, gating reliability is NOT learned per-query.
status: Exploratory adaptive branch, independent test generation frozen before running. No further gate tuning on test.
